theme.description: Modern premium dark theme tailored for high-end snooker lounges. It blends the cinematic, moody depth of luxury with the high-visibility tactical precision of performance tracking. The interface uses deep obsidian blacks, very dark grays, and striking billiard green accents to mimic the felt of a snooker table under spotlight.

login_background.description: Cinematic blue and black billiard table with dramatic top lighting, used for the login page split-screen background.

iconography.style: Duotone or Regular weight for a modern, crisp appearance. Used heavily in the sidebar and dashboard KPI cards.

testing.requirement: All interactive elements, forms, and major informational displays MUST use 'data-testid' attributes (e.g., data-testid='start-session-btn', data-testid='table-card-1').

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the entire application forces the dark mode background (#0A0A0A). Do not use light mode or generic white backgrounds.
Use Phosphor Icons for all UI icons to maintain the premium feel.
Implement the 'Control Room' grid layout for the Admin Dashboard. KPIs should be dense, clear, and feature subtle green/red trend indicators.
For the Table Management view, the 'Running' state should prominently display a pulsing live timer (using font-mono) and the current estimated bill.
The Start/End Session dialogs must be clean. The hourly rate should be auto-fetched from the table settings and LOCKED in the UI (disabled input) so staff cannot edit it manually.
Invoice/Billing generation should render a clean, printable view that overrides dark mode styling via CSS @media print { ... } for standard white-paper printing.
Use Shadcn UI primitives but strictly override their default styles to match this dark, rounded (rounded-2xl/rounded-xl), large-button premium aesthetic.
